'''Jhantorian wine''' was an expensive variety of [[Wine/Legends|wine]] drunk during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was served at the reception party thrown by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valles Santhe]] in her [[Santhe Mansion|family manor]] for the arrival of the [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Rodin Hlian Verpalion]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. At the party the wine flowed from the mouth of a large fountain in the shape of a [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]], which was the centerpiece of a buffet table in the dining area of the manor.<ref name="MTL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jhantorian wine first appeared in ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', an adventure [[Book/Legends|book]] released in [[1992]] and written by [[Joanne E. Wyrick]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.
